description: A web-based todo list application that lets users register, log in, and manage tasks with configurable priority levels. Tasks can be created, edited, deleted, and viewed sorted by priority.
core_features: Create tasks with selectable priority (Low, Medium, High)
Edit existing tasks and change their priority
Dashboard displaying tasks sorted by priority
future_features: Task categories and tags for better organization
Recurring tasks with automatic schedule generation
Sharing tasks or lists with other registered users

milestones: Implement user registration and login with JWT
Create Task CRUD endpoints with priority field
Build React dashboard showing tasks sorted by priority
Add due date handling and visual indicators
Implement client‑side filtering and sorting by priority and due date
Introduce user settings page for profile updates
Add task categories/tags and UI for tag management
Implement recurring task logic on the backend
Enable task sharing between users with permission controls
